in_marathi.name: Neelakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blue Lotus Eye
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neelakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Neelakshi is derived from two Sanskrit words: Neela (blue) and Akshi (eye). It represents the divine goddess Parvati, who is known for her beautiful blue lotus eyes. In Hindu mythology, Neelakshi is considered a symbol of beauty, grace, and divine protection.
